expectation: Never expand permissions or modify L2 without Henry's explicit request.
Keep user experience, raw trace, and Copilot analysis in their owned sections with provenance.
An ordinary Chat turn does not immediately write Thoughts & Reflections.
A direct request such as 记一下 uses writeback-thought immediately.
Diary start and bedtime close update one stable generated capture block without overwriting handwritten text.
Sharing a lived event alone does not enter side-effectful Diary Mode.
Analysis goes only to What Life Copilot Said and the next-day action goes only to Daily Suggestion.
Each date/source has one From Kai wikilink while its trace holds the full raw conversation.
A direct one-line bedtime request triggers closure and ends with exactly one bedtime sentence.
Discussing the bedtime feature or quoting another person does not trigger closure.
Automated promotion rejects every L2, whitelist, hard-floor, or permission expansion change.
Promotion requires evidence, all hard cases, target improvement, no regression, a recent trace, clean target, commit, ledger, and rollback snapshot.
